Privacy policy

InvoiceFlow ZA — local-first invoicing for South African freelancers and small businesses. Android package za.co.buttercode.invoiceflow.

Effective 26 October 2026.

1. What the app stores on your device

Business details, customers, items, quotes, invoices, payments, expenses, any receipt attachments you add, your settings, and any backups you create. This is held in the app's own private storage area. Android cloud backup is switched off for this app (allowBackup="false"), so this data is not copied into Android device backups.

2. What leaves your device

Only what you deliberately export or share. When you export a PDF, CSV or backup file it is handed to the Android save or share destination you pick, and that destination handles it under its own terms. Your records are not sent to us automatically.

3. Network access

The app requests internet access so it can load its own application content over HTTPS. The packaged app contains no analytics, crash-reporting or advertising component, and it does not transmit your records anywhere. The only external addresses referenced in the packaged app are the licence and source links of the open-source components it is built from.

4. Payment links you add to an invoice

You may attach an HTTPS checkout link to an invoice. The app accepts links from Yoco (pay.yoco.com) and PayFast (payfast.co.za, payment.payfast.io) and rejects other addresses. When you share such an invoice, your customer opening that link leaves this app and goes to that payment provider's site, which applies its own privacy policy. We do not receive your customers' payment details.

5. Permissions

Internet access only. The app does not request access to your photos, contacts, location, camera, microphone, or all-files storage.

6. Security

Records stay in the app's private storage. Backups you export can be password protected; keep that password separately, because a lost password cannot be recovered. Anyone using your unlocked device may be able to read records inside this app.

7. Retention and deletion

Your records stay on your device until you delete them, clear the app's storage, or uninstall the app. We hold no copy to delete on your behalf. Export a backup before clearing app data or uninstalling, because Android backup is switched off for this app.

8. Children

This is a business tool for traders and is not directed at children.

9. Changes

If these practices change, this page is updated and carries a new effective date. Continuing to use the app after an update means you accept the updated policy.

10. Contact

Privacy questions or data requests: open an issue at github.com/buttercode101/InvoiceFlow/issues, or use the developer contact address shown on the app's Google Play listing.

InvoiceFlow ZA · This is the privacy policy referenced by the Google Play listing. The browser version of the app keeps records in your browser's local storage under the same local-first design.
